explication: workmux is a Rust CLI that coordinates Git worktrees, terminal-multiplexer windows, and coding agents. The principal workflow is: a user invokes a command, configuration is resolved, a worktree is created and prepared, a multiplexer workspace launches an agent, and status/UI surfaces monitor it. Merge and removal reverse that lifecycle. The graph also preserves documented setup hooks, file operations, dashboards, sidebar monitoring, PR integrations, LLM naming, and sandboxed agents. Some command-to-module calls are inferred from the documented public workflow API and module structure; unsampled internals are not expanded.
